sloka: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रसादो रघुनन्दन ।यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव ।। ७.८६.२० ॥
transliteration: īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prasādo raghunandana ।yajasva sumahābhāga hayamedhena pārthiva ।। 7.86.20 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, such indeed is the efficacy of the Ashwamedha sacrifice; therefore, O greatly fortunate king, perform the horse sacrifice.
